About

"Me in the space building alone, hunting alone. Making my W's alone and L's alone."

I started web3 as a raider — making $15 a week and happy with that. Somewhere along the way I figured out something small to build, and kept building it. No agency, no team handed to me on day one — just spaces, timelines, and a lot of reps. That's the same energy every project gets when I work with them: no hesitation, just attention turned into traction.
